title: Database connection pool exhausted on checkout-db
description: Customers on the checkout page are seeing intermittent 'unable to complete order' errors. Application logs show the checkout service repeatedly failing to acquire a connection from the primary database pool during a traffic spike.
raw_logs: 2026-08-24T09:06:12.400Z WARN  [checkout-service] db pool utilization 88% (88/100), wait queue forming
2026-08-24T09:08:47.100Z ERROR [checkout-service] Timed out waiting for database connection pool 'HikariPool-1' after 30000ms
2026-08-24T09:10:22.900Z ERROR [checkout-db] too many connections for role checkout_app: 100/100 slots in use
2026-08-24T09:11:38.500Z ERROR [checkout-service] SQLTransientConnectionException: HikariPool-1 - Connection is not available, request timed out after 30000ms
2026-08-24T09:12:55.300Z WARN  [checkout-service] connection acquisition wait p95=29200ms; wait queue depth 214
2026-08-24T09:14:10.800Z ERROR [lb-checkout] 37.5% of checkout requests failing with 500/503 during pool exhaustion window

raw_events.description: Rolled out checkout-service v2.14.0 (raised default query timeout, no pool size change)
Request rate 4.2x above 7-day baseline (flash sale campaign)
